WhatsApp introduces username reservations for private chats

Meta has introduced a new feature that allows WhatsApp users to reserve usernames for their private chats. This move is part of the app's efforts to enhance user experience and provide more control over their online presence. The new feature will be rolled out globally over the next few months, allowing users to create unique identities for their private conversations. As Meta continues to evolve its services, this development highlights the company's focus on improving user engagement and privacy.
